attributes.Software: DeepVariant per sample, joint-genotyped across the case by GLnexus (nf-core/raredisease)
attributes.FilterMethod: None beyond normalisation: bcftools norm, with mitochondrial calls moved to their own VCF (raredisease output docs). One VCF per case_id, holding every sample of the case

attributes.Software: GATK Mutect2 in mitochondrial mode, on two alignments with opposite breakpoints (nf-core/raredisease)
attributes.FilterMethod: None beyond normalisation: the GATK mitochondrial short-variant workflow's calls, normalised (raredisease output docs). One VCF per case_id. Written for wgs runs, and for wes only with run_mt_for_wes

attributes.Software: SVDB merge of Manta, TIDDIT and CNVnator calls, plus GATK GermlineCNVCaller unless skipped (nf-core/raredisease)
attributes.FilterMethod: None: the structural-variant and copy-number calls merged by SVDB, including mitochondrial SVs. One VCF per case_id

unmapped_files.why: The mitochondrial reads of the registered alignment, subsampled for the MT deletion and visualisation steps: a subset of the registered BAM, not a second alignment.
Picard MarkDuplicates metrics for the registered alignment; their numbers are read through MultiQC.

rhocall, vcfanno, CADD and VEP annotated copies of the registered SNV and mitochondrial VCFs, with their ROH and UPD plots: snv_annotation and mt_annotation are skipped in Luria launches (VEP cache, gnomAD and vcfanno resources are not staged), and an annotated copy is not a second call set.
SVDB-query and VEP annotated copy of the registered SV VCF: sv_annotation is skipped in Luria launches (its databases and VEP cache are not staged), and a copy is not a second call set.
Annotated mobile-element calls: me_annotation is skipped in Luria launches (its SVDB databases and VEP cache are not staged). README lists them as an output with no rule.
GENMOD-ranked clinical and research subsets of the annotated VCFs: they exist only when annotation runs, which Luria launches skip. README lists them as an output with no rule.
RetroSeq mobile-element insertion calls: me_calling is skipped in Luria launches (mobile_element_references is not staged). README lists them as an output with no rule.
MitoSAlt and Saltshaker mitochondrial deletion calls, plots and their per-case VCF: no sample type means mitochondrial deletion calls yet. README lists them.
MitoSAlt's per-sample mitochondrial deletion table: no sample type means it yet. README lists it.
Per-read-file FastQC reports; their numbers are read through MultiQC.
fastp reports and the trimmed FASTQs fastp writes before alignment: QC read through MultiQC, and reads that are an intermediate of the registered alignment.

Per-sample alignment QC (mosdepth, Picard CollectMultipleMetrics, CollectWgsMetrics, CollectHsMetrics, TIDDIT coverage tracks and chromograph plots): their summary numbers are read through MultiQC, and coverage tracks have no sample type.
ngs-bits' sex inferred from each alignment, a check of the samplesheet's sex: D.SEQ has no inferred-sex attribute. README lists it.
peddy's pedigree, sex and relatedness checks for the case: no sample type or attribute holds them yet. README lists them.
The PED file raredisease writes from the samplesheet's pedigree columns: the run's input restated, not a result.
ExpansionHunter and Stranger repeat-expansion calls and BAMlets: repeat_calling is skipped in Luria launches (variant_catalog is not staged). README lists them.
SMNCopyNumberCaller's SMN1 and SMN2 copy numbers for the case: no sample type means them yet. README lists them.
Per-sample CGH files for the CytoSure viewer, a rendering of the registered SV calls, not a call set of their own.
